children: The RBNZ is likely to raise rates sooner than expected, three members of Goldman Sachs's Research team say in a report. Following increasingly hawkish comments from RBNZ officials, New Zealand's central bank is now expected to lift its official cash rate by 25 basis points to 3.00% in December and by a final 25 bps to 3.25% in March, the members say. Previously, GS had expected 25bp rate increases in February and June 2027. "That said, we expect the decision will be a more balanced decision than currently implied by market pricing and still contingent on developments ahead of the 9 December meeting," the members add.(ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
